transcript: Carly Rae Jepsen and Lena Dunham have written a 10 things I hate about you musical based on the movie of the same name, which just announced that it is coming to Broadway next season, officially making it the first show of the 2027, 2028 Broadway season. Now, if you haven't seen the 1999 film, it is essentially a contemporary adaptation of Shakespeare's Taming of the shrew, which is the same Shakespeare play that inspired Kiss Me, Kate. And I'm very curious if they choose to keep it set in the 90s or bring it into present day. But either way, I think it's a really fun property to adapt, and I'm really excited to see what Carly Rae Jepsen does with the score. Now, a couple of interesting things about this announcement. Number one is they are opening cold on Broadway, meaning they are not doing a pre Broadway try out, which is pretty rare, but it's starting to become more common, most recently seen this past season with The Lost Boys. And that's because shows are getting more and more expensive to develop. But the other interesting thing about this announcement is that we have a first preview date. They are opening on Broadway August 17th, 2027, exactly a year from today. Usually when a show announces this far out, they'll just say, we're coming next year or we're coming next fall. And there are even shows coming in the spring that we don't have official dates for. And so It's pretty wild to see a show claim a date so far in advance, and it will be interesting to see if they're able to stick to that date because so much can change in a year.
